title: Powell Industries announces first quarter fiscal 2026 results
publisher: Powell Industries, Inc. via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: Fiscal Q1 revenue was USD 251.2 million, gross margin 28.4%, new orders USD 439 million, backlog USD 1.6 billion, and data-center orders well above USD 100 million.
summary: The SEC-filed release establishes the first fiscal-2026 data-center megaproject, a roughly 1.7x book-to-bill ratio, quarterly revenue and margin progression, and a USD 501 million cash and short-term-investment balance.
